hero.intro: Final-trimester Computer Science and Engineering student at United International University, building reliable software and intelligent systems — from full-stack web platforms to secure transactions and search-and-rescue robots.

about.heading: Building reliable software and intelligent systems.
paragraphs: I'm a final-trimester Computer Science and Engineering student at United International University (CGPA 3.85/4.00) with hands-on experience in full-stack software development, cybersecurity, applied cryptography, AI/ML and embedded robotics.

I've built web platforms, AI-enabled applications, secure transaction systems and multi-sensor robotic prototypes. My research paper on energy-efficient multimodal AI for smart agriculture was accepted at IEEE i-COSTE 2026.
